facts.fact: The Assemblée nationale de Madagascar publishes five parliamentary datasets (deputies, legislative texts, sittings, commissions, parliamentary groups) as JSON and CSV on its open data page and read-only REST API; the page was captured 2026-08-09 and carries no date of its own.
The page states the Assembly's data is published under Licence Ouverte v2.0 (compatible CC-BY), free to reuse including commercially with attribution; date is the capture date as the page has none.
